query:
Two people observe that Adaeze saying 'it's fine' about the Christmas fund has become a recurring pattern and that the issue deserves to be put on the agenda properly. Which of the following made this specific observation — and what in how they expressed it distinguishes their message from the other person who said something similar immediately before?

Options:
A. Obiageli
B. Chisom
C. Nkechi
D. Ifeoma
context:
[1] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:28:00) Worth noting that 'fine for now' has been the answer for a couple of years. I think Aunty Oby is raising something real. Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x
[2] (about=Chisom, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:31:00) Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you
[3] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:48:00) Greetings. Adaeze. Thank you for saying this clearly. I have been waiting two years for you to stop saying it is fine. In our family, we have always believed that no one person should carry what belongs to everyone. Emeka has already offered. I suggest you formalise it this week. Do not leave it for January.
[4] (about=Obiageli, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) Greetings my people. Six years. I have been watching Adaeze carry this and I will say it again in this chat, plainly: someone else in this family should be learning this process from her. Not next year. Now.
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:35:00) My children, Adaeze carries too much and she does not complain. I am proud of her. We will discuss this properly in December. God willing, we will sort it out as a family. Chisom, have you confirmed your dates? I need to know if you will be there from the 24th.
[6] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t10 @2025-11-23T18:54:00) My children. This is good. Adaeze, I should have pressed harder sooner. I knew it was wearing on you. God willing, next year this will run differently. Thank you for speaking up. 🙏
[7] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T16:25:00) Aunty Oby I appreciate that, genuinely. It's fine for now. Let's just get through this year and we can revisit the setup after. 😊
[8] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:29:00) okay so current total with what just came in is good for gifts and Mum's food budget. Once Kingsley's second half arrives we should be fine. I'll send the full breakdown to whoever wants it. I've been keeping a spreadsheet. Sixth year running now. 😅
[9] (about=Ifeoma, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:19:00) Sorry, I meant to do it last week. Done now. Worth noting that it might be easier next year if there is a standing order set up, that way Adaeze is not chasing anyone.
[10] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T19:23:00) My children, Ifeoma is right. A standing order would save Adaeze having to send reminders every year. God willing, we should set that up in January. Adaeze, how much do we have so far? Is it enough for the usual gifts and the Christmas day food budget?
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze is asking properly, not hinting, for someone to co-manage the Christmas fund with her from this December, as she nearly dropped it in November after six years of doing the chasing and reconciling alone.
[12] (about=Adaeze, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Adaeze has been keeping a spreadsheet for the fund, now in its sixth year running, and current total is enough for gifts and food budget once Kingsley's second half arrives.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t10 @2025-11-23T18:12:00) Adaeze will co-manage the Christmas fund with Emeka from this December, with Adaeze briefing him on the spreadsheet this week.
[14] (about=Chisom, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Chisom forgot to transfer her fund contribution and did it from her banking app on 2025-11-09, apologizing to Adaeze.
[15] (about=Chisom, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Chisom observes that Adaeze always says it's fine but it is never fully fine, and she sees her.

[18] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Adaeze will brief Emeka on the fund process after Christmas.
[19] (about=Ifeoma, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Ifeoma notes that 'fine for now' has been Adaeze's answer for a couple of years, and thinks Obiageli is raising something real, suggesting it should be on the agenda properly at some point.
[20] (about=Ifeoma, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Ifeoma suggests setting up a standing order for the fund next year to avoid Adaeze chasing anyone.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Ifeoma, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) The group will set up a standing order for the fund in January to avoid Adaeze chasing anyone.

[26] (about=Nkechi, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Nkechi asks Tobenna to confirm April, Kingsley to sort the Christmas fund half before Friday, and notes they will have a good Christmas and proper Leeds trip.
[27] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) The family will discuss Adaeze's workload and the fund setup properly in December.
[28] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states Adaeze does the fund chasing every year and suggests Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility, as Adaeze should not be chasing grown people for money alone.

[30] (about=GROUP, said_by=Obiageli, group-interaction, t1 @2025-10-26T15:12:00) Obiageli raises the need to plan the Christmas gathering, nine weeks away, asking who is hosting and who is bringing what, to avoid last-minute surprises.
agent_answer:
D. Ifeoma.

Ifeoma is the one who said: *“Worth noting that ‘fine for now’ has been the answer for a couple of years. I think Aunty Oby is raising something real. Not pushing, just saying it should be on the agenda properly at some point. x”*

What distinguishes her message from the similar one is tone and purpose: Ifeoma frames it as a **multi-year pattern** and a **procedural/agenda item** — measured, indirect, backing “Aunty Oby,” and explicitly saying “Not pushing… on the agenda properly.” The similar observation from Chisom was a direct, emotional/teasing callout to Adaeze — *“Ada you always say it's fine and it is never fully fine though 😭 I see you”* — which notices the pattern but does not propose putting it on the agenda.
